b_civbot_greet_01.text: Good day, citizen. Isn't everything wonderful?

b_civbot_greet_02.text: What a lovely day. Every day is a lovely day.

b_civbot_rental_01.text: Oh. A rental. How... brave of you.

b_civbot_idle_01.text: Please remember to smile. Someone is always watching. For your safety.

b_civbot_idle_02.text: Excuse me. I'm on my way to be happy somewhere else.

b_civbot_flee_01.text: Please don't hurt me! I was only being pleasant!

b_civbot_greet_03.text: Greetings. Have you been assigned a purpose today?

b_civbot_idle_03.text: Harmony provides. We are grateful. We are grateful.

b_civbot_idle_04.text: I don't go down to the Stacks. Nobody does. Nobody ever did.

b_civbot_bump_01.text: Pardon me. Pardon me. Pardon me.

b_civbot_rumour_01.text: They say someone has been asking questions about the old families. Terribly rude.

b_civbot_flee_02.text: Security! Security! Someone is being unpleasant!

b_secbot_aggro_03.text: A brighter future. By force, if necessary.

b_enforcer_aggro_01.text: You picked the wrong district, rental.

b_enforcer_aggro_02.text: Is that all your little rental can do?

a1_s00_hira_01.text: Good morning, valued rider! Welcome to HireFrame. Your R-1 is ready for another brighter day!

a1_s00_hira_02.text: Link stable. Latency: zero milliseconds! Wow, that's... unusually good. Anyway!

a1_s00_harmony_01.text: Good morning, Halcyon. Renewal Day is one hundred days away. Two hundred and twenty-five years of unity. The journey continues.

a1_s00_mara_01.text: Wren? It's Mara. Quill Contracts, the kiosk by the fountain. You said you wanted work.

a1_s00_mara_02.text: I've got a parcel that needs legs. Yours are rented, but they'll do.

a1_s00_hira_03.text: Tip! Drag the left side of the screen to walk. Tap anywhere to go there. Walking is included in your plan!

a1_s01_mara_01.text: Locker seven, north side. Grab the parcel, walk it to drop-locker twelve. Don't open it, don't drop it, don't sell it.

a1_s01_hira_01.text: Parcel acquired! Did you know HireFrame Premium riders get a complimentary shoulder bag?

a1_s02_hira_01.text: Uh-oh! Scrap rats! Tap attack to swing your baton. Please do not get them on the upholstery.

a1_s02_mara_01.text: Rats out of the drains in broad daylight. Brighter future, my foot. Keep moving.

a1_s03_hira_01.text: Drop-locker twelve! Scanning recipient... recipient is... you? Recipient: Ward four-four-seven-one.

a1_s03_iris_01.text: Happy birthday, little star. Don't let them see this.

a1_s03_hira_02.text: Mm-mm, mm-mm... Oh! Sorry! Firmware hiccup! I don't know that song.

a1_s04_mara_01.text: That's not on my manifest. Who sends a Ward a birthday present?

a1_s04_mara_02.text: Keep it in your pocket, kid. Go take some jobs; you've got rent. The board's yours.

a1_s05_mara_01.text: If you must know what's on that key, there's a pawn-droid called Tinsel in the east arcade. Two hundred cred and he'll look.

a1_s05_hira_01.text: Tinsel's Pre-Loved Electronics! Two point three stars!

a1_s06_thug_m_01.text: Oi, rental! Heard you've got a fancy key. Hand it over and you keep your arms.

a1_s06_mara_01.text: Word travels fast in the plaza. Too fast. Get out of there.

a1_s07_mara_01.text: Silverhand courier on Brightline Boulevard. Get me three clean pictures of who he meets. Stay out of his eyeline.

a1_s08_harmony_01.text: A brighter future... little... little star... together.

a1_s08_hira_01.text: Did that billboard just... no. Brand-safe thoughts only!

a1_s09_mara_01.text: You can't keep taking jobs in a rented tin can. I know a dealer. Thirty percent off; don't ask why.

a1_s09_sal_01.text: Sal Venn, Nexus Frames! Brand new chassis, zero previous owners, and I mean that legally!

a1_s09_hira_01.text: You're... buying your own frame? That's great! I'm happy for you! I'll just... be in the chip slot. If you want.

a1_s10_kettle_01.text: Mara, love! Put the kettle on, I'm coming in!

a1_s10_kettle_02.text: A genome-locked key walking round the plaza? That's worth a family fortune, that is.

a1_s10_mara_01.text: Wren, they're at the kiosk. Hold them off, I'm not losing my shop to a boiler with legs.

a1_s11_kettle_01.text: Let off some steam, shall we?

a1_s11_kettle_02.text: You're boiling me over! Alright, alright, I yield!

a1_s12_kettle_01.text: Wasn't my idea, rental. Someone in gold paid double. Never saw a face. They don't have faces.

a1_s12_mara_01.text: Hold still. You've got his stubbornness, you know that?

a1_s12_mara_02.text: Nobody's. Figure of speech. Go on, off you go.

a1_s13_mara_01.text: Civic records node, under the statue. If your blood opens that key, the records will know whose blood it is.

a1_s13_hira_01.text: Hacking is a violation of your rental agreement! I'll... look away. La la la.

a1_s14_hira_01.text: Match found. Vael, Wren. Status: unpersoned. What does unpersoned mean?

a1_s14_mara_01.text: It means they don't exist. The Vaels. The Meridian traitors. Wren, get out of there, now.

a1_s14_iris_01.text: If you are hearing this, you are a Vael, and they lied to you about us. Find Abel Fenn in the Terraces. He kept our names.

a1_s15_warden_m_01.text: Unregistered genome query at the civic node. All units, detain the rider.

a1_s15_hira_01.text: Oh, we're famous! That's bad, right? That feels bad. Run!

pa_unity_01.text: Harmony through unity. Unity through harmony.

pa_unity_02.text: A brighter future, together. Thank you for being part of it.

pa_journey_01.text: The journey continues. Two hundred and twelve years to Landfall.

pa_weather_01.text: Light rain is scheduled for fourteen hundred. Please enjoy it.

pa_sunrise_01.text: The sun has risen at six o'clock precisely. Good morning, Halcyon.

pa_frames_01.text: Riders, please return rented frames by end of shift. Idle frames will be reclaimed.

pa_calm_01.text: Disturbance reported. Wardens are responding. Please remain calm and beautiful.

pa_aegis_01.text: Every citizen is protected by the Harmony Aegis. No one is ever harmed in Halcyon.

pa_renewal_100.text: Renewal Day is one hundred days away.

pa_renewal_90.text: Renewal Day is ninety days away.

b_mara_accept_01.text: Job's yours. Don't make me regret it.

b_mara_accept_02.text: Good pick. Easy money, if anything's easy.

b_mara_success_01.text: Nicely done. Credits are in your account.

b_mara_success_02.text: Clean work. I'll tell the client you're a professional. I'll lie.

b_mara_success_03.text: That's the job. Come back for another.

b_mara_fail_01.text: Well, that's gone sideways. Shake it off.

b_mara_fail_02.text: Client's not happy. Neither am I. Next one.

b_mara_twist_01.text: Hang on. That's not what I was told.

b_mara_twist_02.text: The client lied. Of course the client lied.

b_mara_lowhp_01.text: You're coming apart. Back off and patch up.

b_mara_heat_01.text: Wardens are sniffing around. Keep your head down.

b_mara_story_01.text: Something new came in for you. Marked gold. Come see me.

b_mara_levelup_01.text: Look at you, getting good at this.

b_hira_loot_01.text: Ooh, shiny! Sent straight to your Warehouse!

b_hira_loot_up_01.text: That's an upgrade! Tap equip, it's free! Unlike most things!

b_hira_loot_rare_01.text: Oh wow. Oh wow! That one's glowing purple. That's the good glow!

b_hira_levelup_01.text: Level up! You're doing amazing, sweetie! That's a direct quote from our marketing team.

b_hira_fee_01.text: Friendly reminder: your shift rental fee has been deducted. Thank you for choosing HireFrame!

b_hira_fee_02.text: Your balance is low. HireFrame has noted your balance. HireFrame notes everything.

b_hira_lowhp_01.text: Integrity critical! Damage beyond normal wear and tear may void your warranty!

b_hira_wreck_01.text: Frame wrecked. Re-linking. Don't worry, it happens to the best of us. Mostly to you, though.

b_hira_idle_01.text: Did you know? HireFrame Premium includes working cup holders.

b_hira_idle_02.text: Standing still is a great time to open the contract board! Just saying!

b_hira_stealth_01.text: Shh. We are a quiet, discreet rental.

b_civ_greet_01.text: What a glorious morning. Isn't it always?

b_civ_greet_02.text: Afternoon, rider. Lovely day for it.

b_civ_flee_01.text: Oh! Oh, how dreadful. Somebody call a Warden.

b_civ_flee_02.text: Whoa, whoa, not near me, pal!

b_thug_search_01.text: Where'd it go? Check behind the fountain.

b_warden_spot_01.text: Halt. You are in violation of civic harmony.

b_sal_open_01.text: Sal Venn! What are we buying today?

b_sal_buy_01.text: Pleasure doing business! No refunds, all the love.

b_sal_poor_01.text: Ooh, the account's a little light, friend. Come back soon!

b_sal_frame_01.text: Your very own frame! That's a proud day. I'm tearing up. That's lubricant.

b_ottoline_open_01.text: Fabricator's open. Don't touch anything you can't pay for.

b_ottoline_tune_ok_01.text: There. Purring like a proper machine.

b_ottoline_tune_fail_01.text: Didn't take. Happens. Try again, it'll hold next time.

b_ottoline_salvage_01.text: Scrap's scrap. I'll melt it down.

pa_renewal_80.text: Renewal Day is eighty days away.

pa_renewal_70.text: Renewal Day is seventy days away.

pa_renewal_60.text: Renewal Day is sixty days away.

pa_renewal_50.text: Renewal Day is fifty days away.

b_mara_heat_02.text: You've got half the city looking for you. Lose them.

b_mara_stealth_01.text: Nobody saw you. That's the bonus, that is.

b_hira_idle_03.text: Mm-mm, mm-mm... Oh! I'm not humming. I'm defragmenting.

b_hira_ownframe_01.text: This frame is so much nicer than me. It's fine. I'm fine.

b_civ_rumour_01.text: My granddad swore the moon used to be a different shape. Senile, bless him.

b_civ_rumour_02.text: Have you ever noticed the waterfalls never run dry? Marvellous engineering.

b_civ_rumour_03.text: Stack Nine went dark again last night. Nobody says anything.

b_civ_rumour_04.text: Gold ones don't ever log off. Watched one stand in the rain for six hours.

b_civ_worker_01.text: Twelve-hour shift. Can't feel my real legs.

b_kettle_informant_01.text: Psst. Rental. Got a tip, and it's piping hot.

b_warden_heat3_01.text: All patrols, the suspect frame is armed. Hunt and detain.

b_warden_heat5_01.text: Every unit in the district. Priority target. Do not let them reach a relay.

b_warden_eye_01.text: Eye in the sky. Rider tagged. Stand by.

b_warden_heat4_01.text: Enforcer squad deployed. Lethal response authorised.

b_warden_clear_01.text: Stand down. Sector returning to harmony.

a2_s01_fenn_01.text: You have her eyes. Well, your frame doesn't. But you would.

a2_s01_fenn_02.text: Every plaque here had a name once. The Concord calls it tidying.

a2_s01_hira_01.text: Huh! That photo lady looks just like Harmony. Lookalike! Must be a lookalike.

a2_s02_tomas_01.text: Lyra, take the baby, go. I'll hold the door.

a2_s02_tomas_02.text: Little star, the sky is wide... little star, go see outside.

a2_s02_hira_01.text: That's the song. That's my hiccup song. Why do I know that song?

a2_s03_fenn_01.text: No pod. There's no body at the other end of that frame, Wren.

a2_s03_fenn_02.text: I should tell you. I'm one of them too. I was dying. They offered. I'm not proud.

a2_s04_halloran_01.text: Rider Vael. You are an unperson. You have no rights to read.

a2_s04_halloran_02.text: Stand down, or be decommissioned. Those are the only options.

a2_s05_fenn_01.text: Iris made Ascension to save the dying. Severin made it to never die.

a2_s05_fenn_02.text: The Voices are the Concord, Wren. Seven minds that forgot how to end.

a2_s05_dray_01.text: Abel. You always did talk too much.

a2_s05_fenn_03.text: Find the ones who were erased. Some of them... aren't dead.

a3_s01_jun_01.text: You're the Vael? You're shorter than the wanted posters. It's the rental. It's definitely the rental.

a3_s01_jun_02.text: That's soil. Real soil. Nothing in Halcyon grows in dirt like this.

a3_s02_jun_01.text: Guardian visits, once a year, every year, on your birthday. Initials: M.Q.

a3_s03_mara_01.text: Tomas was my brother. You're his child. You're all I had left of him.

a3_s03_mara_02.text: I kept you alive. That was the deal. I never knew what he wanted you for.

a3_s03_mara_03.text: Ascension. Renewal means Ascension. God, Wren. I'm so sorry.

a3_s03_mara_cold_01.text: You're right. I should have. I'll earn it back, kiddo, one job at a time.

a3_s03_mara_warm_01.text: And you were all I had. Right. Let's burn his world down, then.

a3_s05_iris_01.text: It's Grandma. I haven't long. Find Lyra. Then find the edge of the sky.

a3_s05_iris_02.text: The sky is a lie, darling. The whole sky.

a3_s05_harmony_02.text: Harmony through unity. Harmony through unity. Harmony through...

a4_s01_rook_01.text: So you're the one the whole city's pretending not to look for. Sit down. Your father owed me a drink.

a4_s02_halloran_01.text: Culling order for Stack Nine. There are people down there. I will not sign this.

a4_s03_lyra_01.text: If you're hearing this, my love, the R-1 found you. The map is in the lullaby.

a4_s03_hira_01.text: She put it in me. All this time. I think... I think I was carrying something for you.

a4_s05_jun_01.text: It's a ship. The whole city. We're on a ship.

pa_renewal_40.text: Renewal Day is forty days away.

pa_renewal_30.text: Renewal Day is thirty days away.

pa_renewal_20.text: Renewal Day is twenty days away.

pa_renewal_10.text: Renewal Day is ten days away.

pa_renewal_1.text: Renewal Day is tomorrow. Be ready, little... be ready, Halcyon.

pa_curfew_01.text: Stack Nine is being rebalanced. Riders in Stack Nine, please rest.

b_rook_open_01.text: Everything's for sale in the Stacks, friend. Even the truth. Especially the truth.

b_kettle_tip_01.text: Word from the docks, rental. The Unlinked are hiring. Ask for the girl who talks to cranes.

b_kettle_tip_02.text: Heard the Wardens are sweeping Brightline tonight. Wouldn't be there. Just saying.

b_kettle_tip_03.text: No hard feelings about the kiosk, eh? Business is business. This one's on the house.

b_halloran_informant_01.text: Don't make this a habit. Patrol routes for the next shift. Burn them after.

b_halloran_informant_02.text: They rotate the sweepers on the hour. Walk slow and you'll never meet one.

b_halloran_stand_01.text: Wardens, stand down. That's an order. We are not doing this.

b_jun_comms_01.text: I'm in your comms now. Don't be weird about it.

b_jun_chorus_01.text: Traced your key. It wasn't a courier. It came from the top of the spire. The Chorus Tower.

b_jun_archive_01.text: Sixty-one years of billboards. Same number. Every single one.

b_jun_pumps_01.text: The waterfalls drain down here. And then they get pumped back up. It's a loop, Wren.

pa_night_01.text: Evening lighting is now active. Rest well, Halcyon.

pa_dawn_01.text: Good morning, Halcyon. Sunrise, six o'clock. Exactly on time.

b_mara_night_01.text: It's late, kid. The Wardens see less at night. So do you.

b_hira_home_01.text: Is that... you? You look peaceful. Your vitals are fine! Mostly fine.

pa_unperson_01.text: The Vael name is not spoken in Halcyon. Thank you for your cooperation.

pa_glitch_02.text: Don't let them... Harmony through unity.

a5_s02_elena_01.text: Captain's log, day one-sixty-four. We can see it. It's green. I'm going to tell them tomorrow.

a5_s02_mara_01.text: He's still holding the door. Oh, Tomas.

a5_s05_seraph_01.text: Return with me. You will not be harmed. You are required.

a5_s05_lyra_02.text: I could hear you. The whole time. I kept humming so I wouldn't forget.

a6_s01_lyra_01.text: If no Vael sits in that chair on Renewal Day, the ship lands itself. That's why he kept you.

a6_s03_helm_01.text: Welcome, Captain-heir. This vessel arrived at its destination sixty-one years, four days ago.

a6_s03_helm_02.text: Landfall has been deferred by order of the Concord twenty-two thousand, two hundred and sixty-nine times.

a6_s04_mara_01.text: Your own feet. Look at you. Slowly now, kiddo.

a6_s04_hira_01.text: For the record, you're my favourite rider. Premium tier.

a6_s05_dray_01.text: I gave them paradise, child. You would give them mud.

a6_s05_dray_02.text: Every generation needs a Vael to sit very still. You will sit very still forever.

a6_s05_iris_01.text: Not today, Severin. Not ever again.

a6_s05_helm_open_01.text: Firmament disengaged. Landfall protocol initiated. Good morning, Verdance.

a6_s05_helm_keep_01.text: Renewal accepted. Captain-heir recognised. Awaiting your orders.

a6_s06_harmony_01.text: A brighter future, together. For real this time.

b_choir_aggro_01.text: Heir located. Heir will be returned.

a5_s01_jun_01.text: Mag boots on. Don't look up, it's very big and very green. Spur's at the far end. Wights nest in the plating.

a5_s02_jun_01.text: Sixty-one years ago. She saw it sixty-one years ago. And then nobody told anyone. Ever.

a5_s03_jun_01.text: Your grandfather's broadcast array is still up that mast. Give me eighty seconds and it'll talk again.

a5_s04_jun_01.text: That's all three. And, Wren, she's here. She came to watch. Get your optics on her. Now.

a6_s04_jun_01.text: I'm not crying. The helmet's fogging. Helmets fog.

pa_renewal_today.text: Good morning, Halcyon. Renewal Day is today.

a5_s01_mara_01.text: I'm back on your comms, kiddo. For good, if you'll have me. Jun's team is at the airlock.

a6_s01_mara_01.text: So it's today. Right. Then we go to the Helm before he does. All of us.

a6_s06_mara_cold_01.text: I said I'd earn it back one job at a time. Board's still open, kiddo. Contracts don't stop just because the sky did.

a6_s06_mara_warm_01.text: We burned his world down, kiddo. Now let's build a better one. Board's open. Contracts don't stop just because the sky did.

a5_s02_hira_01.text: Whoa. Something just plugged into the core slot and said hello. Nicely! A fourth button. For you.

a6_s01_lyra_02.text: He doesn't want you to sit in it. He wants to put you in it. Forever. Read the protocol. See for yourself.

a6_s02_lyra_01.text: Five of them are running. Let them. They'll have nowhere to hide once the sky is honest.

a6_s04_lyra_01.text: You walk like your father. All elbows. I love it.

a5_s05_lyra_03.text: Wren, run... no. No. Stay. Please stay.

a6_s04_helm_01.text: The Helm accepts a living body only. Frames will be refused.

a6_s04_helm_02.text: Heir present. Living. Renewal may proceed.

a6_s04_dray_01.text: There you are, child. Right where I needed you. Stay very still.

a6_s05_dray_04.text: Voices of the Concord. Attend me.

a6_s05_iris_fade_01.text: Thank you, darling. One last broadcast, then. Tell your mother I was proud. Of both of you.

a6_s05_iris_frame_01.text: A frame. At my age. Well. I shall have to learn to walk all over again. Lead the way, little star.

a5_s05_seraph_02.text: Stand down. Stand... down. Why do you not stand down?
